## Batch 2 review: R-1-0003 and R-1-0006 through R-1-0012

All eight newly reviewed rules are N/A. The PDD identifies the project as APD/upland REDD and explicitly states: “There are no peat soils and tidal wetlands present in the Marcondes REDD+ Project Area.” The AUDef-agent rule is out of scope because APDef is applicable. RWE requirements are out of scope because the project activity is APD. WRC, peatland, tidal-restoration, and CIW rules are out of scope because the project area has no peat soils or tidal wetlands.

Each accepted quote is PDF-backed with manual provenance, page, section, and span ID. The fresh machine proposal is retained separately as machine-proposal-post-999-review-candidate.json.
